name: Dawnwarden
title: Herald of the Solar Mandate
biography: A horn-masked herald tends the lower terraces of Solvaris’s observatory. Its smaller golden halo answers the same celestial order, but its hands reveal vulnerable seals after every edict.
weakness: Counterattack during the edict’s recovery; ordinary armored hits deal less damage.
origin: The Sunken Orrery, an original fictional PawTrail location

skills.name: Dawn Edict
skills.description: A broad golden hand-sweep locks a forward wedge. Circle behind the herald.

skills.name: Sanctum Ring
skills.description: The halo sends out a marked annulus. Its clear center and outer edge stay safe.

review: Firefox 2026-11-12: corrected artwork loaded; movement/start/pause, Dawn Edict 24 HP and Sanctum Ring 28 HP contact, 720-HP enrage rehearsal and reset observed. Full defeat unreviewed.
